# gradle-wrapper.properties

Source: [priperi/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties](../../../../../priperi/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties)

Pins the Gradle download URL and SHA-256 verification value.

This file is compiled or packaged by the Android build. See [Build](../../../../../docs/BUILD.md). It has no private value to paste unless its configuration note says otherwise.
